subject: general
question:
Select the most suitable option to fill in the blank.

The child was ___________ for stealing the cookies.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' i.e. 'Apprehended'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence suggests someone getting caught or punished for stealing cookies, hinting at the act of being caught or arrested.
 
• 'Apprehended' perfectly conveys this meaning
